markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: The absence of formal 2028 Democratic presidential declarations has kept trader consensus tightly bunched, with Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez clustered near 15-18% as markets weigh regional bases, fundraising potential, and progressive versus swing-state coalition strength. Further separation could emerge from candidate announcements, early fundraising reports, or results in upcoming Senate and gubernatorial contests that test coalition durability ahead of the first contests.
